blocks.text: Solar energy solutions are becoming more accessible to Cebuanos as LONGi, Sungrow, and DJ Solar Corporation bring their latest offerings to SM City Cebu for the Solar Technology Roadshow on October 24, 2026. The event featured the latest solar technologies, products, and services from the LONGi, Sungrow, and DJ Solar Corp, highlighting renewable energy solutions now available to Cebuano consumers. International excellence brought to Cebu When making household decisions, such as switching to alternative sources of energy, homeowners prioritize quality and reliability.
